# MonoGame XNB Test Assets

These are the XNB files distributed by the MonoGame repository under
`Tests/Assets` and `Tests/Interactive/MacOS`. The original paths are preserved.
They are used unchanged as ABI test inputs.

Source: <https://github.com/MonoGame/MonoGame/tree/76ed1c24f7dbe91421023c553978fa723548b22a/Tests>
